versions.content: Initialization of a DataPrototype associated with a Com- puMethod of category BITFIELD_TEXTTABLE The initialization of a DataPro- totype associated with a CompuMethod of category BITFIELD_TEXTTABLE re- quires the simultaneous initialization of all single bits or sets of bits represented by the respective definition of bitmask. Access to the elements is possible by using bit-operations, therefore the initialization needs to be defined in a way that bit-operations can be used to apply the provided value. In other words, the overall value shall be created out of bitwise or-ing (represented by the usage of the “|” symbol) contributions from the individual subsets.
